scope: Immutable dataset manifests for the manual decision ledger, one-time preregistered holdout opening, manifest-bound experiments.
defects_fixed: live recomputed split moved boundaries as data grew
offline runner evaluated test on every dry run

rules.first_manifest: chronological 60/20/20 by data_as_of with 20-day overlap purge
rules.successor_manifest: dates <= previously covered date are train; later dates split first half validation, second half test
rules.hash_scope: decision-time features + human_decision + observed 20-day label; notes and realized P&L excluded
rules.holdout: one opening per manifest with preregistration (unique index); impossible after a successor is frozen
rules.test_report: one experiment per manifest, same family/version/config hash as preregistration (sparse unique index)

tests.note: offline runner tests skip without sklearn/requests

limits: The ledger owner can see all outcomes; the protocol makes test reporting verifiable, not secret.
Pre-manifest (stage 80) experiments have no manifest and are not accepted as test reports.
